brands.name: Dior

brands.description: Legendary French maison synonymous with sophistication, creator of the iconic Chanel N°5.

brands.description: American luxury brand celebrated for bold, sensual and opulent fragrances.

brands.description: Italian elegance and minimalism, famous for Acqua di Giò and Sì collections.

brands.description: Parisian couture house with daring, youthful fragrances like Libre and Black Opium.

brands.name: Carolina Herrera
brands.description: New York elegance with feminine and iconic Good Girl and 212 fragrances.

products.name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
products.description: A fiercely fresh signature with a rugged trail. Inspired by wide-open skies and rocky landscapes, Sauvage embodies raw nobility.
products.shortDescription: Fresh, spicy and woody signature for men.

products.name: J'adore Eau de Parfum
products.description: A sensual floral bouquet, J'adore is a luminous and sensual perfume with jasmine and rose.

products.name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum
products.description: A couture floral creation embroidered with a bright mandarin and sensual rose.

products.name: Dior Homme Intense
products.description: The intensity of an iris accented with amber wood, redefining modern masculinity.

products.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
products.description: A timeless, woody aromatic with a mysterious, invigorating thrill of freedom.

products.name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum
products.description: The very essence of femininity in a bottle. An aldehydic floral masterpiece since 1921.

products.name: Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum
products.description: A vibrant oriental for a free, daring woman who breaks all codes.

products.name: Chance Eau Tendre Eau de Parfum
products.description: A sweet, delicate fruity-floral chance that swirls with grapefruit and jasmine.

products.name: Lost Cherry Eau de Parfum
products.description: A intoxicating contrast of cherry liqueur and almond with warm, woody depths.

products.description: Smoky oud, exotic sandalwood and cardamom — rare Oud Wood addiction.

products.name: Black Orchid Eau de Parfum
products.description: Sensual luxury of dark orchid, truffle and black plum wrapped in warm woods.

products.name: Tobacco Vanille
products.description: Cozy tobacco and creamy vanilla — reminiscent of a private club in London.

products.name: Acqua di Giò Profumo
products.description: A refined aquatic intensity inspired by the sea and volcanic stone.

products.name: Sì Eau de Parfum
products.description: Sì is a tribute to femininity, strength and emotion — sensual and intense.

products.name: Armani Code Eau de Parfum
products.description: A magnetic woody with bergamot and leathered suede for timeless seduction.

products.name: Libre Eau de Parfum
products.description: Libre — freedom — burning freedom, a cool lavender edged with warm vanilla.

products.name: Black Opium Eau de Parfum
products.description: Addictive coffee, jasmine and vanilla — the dangerously glamourous Black Opium.

products.name: Y Eau de Parfum
products.description: A vibrant fougère with fresh bergamot and sage anchored by warm vetiver.

products.name: Mon Paris Eau de Parfum
products.description: A fruity floral vertigo inspired by Paris and the intoxication of love.

products.name: Good Girl Eau de Parfum
products.description: The sensual duality of light and dark — jasmine and cocoa in a stiletto bottle.

products.description: Urban, elegant and charismatic — a fresh floral musk for metropolitan men.

products.name: 212 VIP Rose Eau de Parfum
products.description: A sparkling rosé glamour — champagne, peach blossom and amber.

products.name: 1 Million Eau de Toilette
products.description: A coveted leather and spice opulence — daring, gold and addictive.

products.name: Lady Million Eau de Parfum
products.description: Fresh, sparkling floral — the diamond for a self-made woman.

products.name: Phantom Eau de Toilette
products.description: Futuristic aromatic with energizing lemon, lavender and creamy vanilla.

products.name: Invictus Eau de Toilette
products.description: A triumphant aquatic woody — fresh grapefruit and laurel with amber heat.

products.name: Le Male Le Parfum
products.description: Irresistible captain intensity — spicy cardamom and vanilla woods.

products.name: Scandal Eau de Parfum
products.description: Honeyed gardenia and outrageous patchouli — scandal in a bottle.

products.name: Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum
products.description: Solar white flowers and salty caramel meringue — divinely addicting.

products.name: Eros Eau de Parfum
products.description: A powerful fresh-woody tribute to Greek passion and strength.

products.name: Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette
products.description: A luminescent floral of peony, magnolia and crystalline musk.

products.name: Dylan Blue Pour Homme
products.description: A Mediterranean sea breeze with violet leaf and smoky incense depths.

products.name: Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum
products.description: A mysterious gardenia and spice noir — sensual and ultra-feminine.

products.name: Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum
products.description: A luminous crystal amber and saffron alchemy — the world's most coveted scent.

products.name: Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum
products.description: Juniper and whisky duality with addictive vanilla amber warmth.

products.name: Oud Satin Mood
products.description: A satiny veil of roses and velvety oud in golden light.
